profiles.label: Witches Needle / WN_TOWER

facts.text: Druid-Sec maintains the outer farmlands; fractal craft channels or maintains energy.
Embrite combines black soil-clay outskirts, bio-plast workwear and Greatweb maintenance.
The Harvet extracts neural-wood through a cycle of ash, fertile ground and branch provision.
MOD_OP exchanges verifiable contracts, bio-mods and data rather than ordinary currency.
WN_MED treatment is restricted to contracted clients.
Needlurgy training, black.dot registration and network access have distinct institutional requirements.

lighting.direction: Keep soot and soil-clay legible; separate sterile Sap Core advertisement light from warmer working settlements and druid signatures.

constraints: Do not give Druid-Sec a mandatory uniform; Harvet workers have yellow strap-jackets.
MOD_OP exchange rules do not establish a currency policy for all regions.
A background, reputation or reading a source cannot confer medical coverage or network clearance.
profiles.local_observation: Darkwood grain and patched bio-plast carry different histories of handling; ash gathers most clearly along the repaired seams.

profiles.label: ENACT_HILLS

facts.text: FOOTHILL CUSP civilian life includes washing, cleaning, cooking, farming and basic crafts.
GRAVESITE is a SEC.IO controlled archival and burial boundary with restricted access.
UPPER RUNEHILLS training requires WN_EDU or ED.NET certification; PYRI manages OMNIPILLAR teachings.
MMTX< Lifestring warrior insurance uses salvageable digiPRINT patterns for re-resolution.

lighting.direction: Use readable household surfaces and localized projection signatures. Monument scale remains distinct from small accessible public works.

constraints: SEC.IO is outside ordinary Merc Tag basis.
Do not turn digiPRINT lore into a free respawn or an earned credential.
ENTACT_HILLS and ENNERACT_HILLS spellings in other text are retained as source variants.
profiles.local_observation: Worked metal keeps the marks of repeated repair beside cultivated soil, a household scale of labor beneath the larger administrative forms.

profiles.label: CITY_CLOUD_S

facts.text: The city is a metallurgy construction high in the eastern mountains, isolated from ordinary pilgrimage access.
base.EN_KHO salvages metal; ED.NET is embedded in the mountains and voiced by KHO.
Plat.EN_MID lacks black.dot and Merc Tag regulation, diplomatic ties and consistent Greatweb support.
PEAK.EN_PERCEPT access is policed; OMNI-META.OPEND operates across sectors.
VENDING_PROTOCOL_OMNI uses currency; AUTO-MERCH.OS moves goods through remote vendor connections.

lighting.direction: Preserve the weight of mountain metal and distinct teaching projections. Existing cyan/rose renderer values are artistic approximations, not document wavelengths.

constraints: Do not apply regulated peak rules uniformly to the unregulated middle sector.
A regular pilgrimage route into the source city is not established.
CLOUD_CITY_S is retained as a textual variant, not a second automatically placed city.
profiles.local_observation: Sorting scars and joined edges distinguish the salvaged metal surfaces; geometric lesson frames keep a finer, more deliberate finish.

profiles.label: AETHERGALE

facts.text: Desert winds carry jade and rose contrails; NanoClad pilgrims use bio-plast armor and arcane resource craft.
OMNICURRENT imbues materials and caustic storms carve runic residuals.
PAMAN DAL guides CHECKPOINT.RESID provision; its central lightPROKT< tree supports filtered water.
At CHECKPOINT.CASC, ArK and AETHER fields interact; Lila and Khi have specific recorded conditions.
Aspen-Specie feathered serpents hunt AETHER imbuement around the swirls.
CHECKPOINT.UNDERTOW observes RED>GATE>; the gate resists ordinary physical, meta-state and data penetration.

lighting.direction: Use separate jade and rose signatures across dust and crystal. Emission must leave readable non-emissive surfaces and directional shadows.

constraints: PAMAN DAL provision and death-nullification are source-specific lore, not universal infinite inventory.
Do not resolve Khi’s prism condition by generating an ordinary NPC.
Keep RED>GATE> closed to ordinary traversal.
profiles.local_observation: Wind wear softens the tent fabric while crystalline fragments retain sharper edges; jade and rose belong to the documented AETHER palette.

profiles.label: AquiSphere

facts.text: An omni-crystallin< water battlestation can reform; geoCLEARANCE governs specialized access.
iceTRACK forms stable ground for transport and has verification and equipment requirements.
Structural changes are common and sporadic; lower and middle partitions have separate stability and security roles.
core^PARTITION integrates an admin with the structure; replacement sight is a specialized bio-mod response.
upper^PARTITION retains interior armaments and screening even when the exterior is affected.

lighting.direction: Aim for weighty refractive water and crystalline boundaries. Specific cyan colors or a fluid solver would be engine adaptations.

constraints: No travel coordinate is established by this document.
Do not represent an exterior change as automatic loss of interior armament.
Reformation needs topology and collision reconciliation before becoming a playable event.

profiles.label: The ArK / seed-core.alpha

facts.text: seed-core.alpha comes from omni-bio mutation and infi-nano perpetuation; research observes southeast expansion.
BRANCHES_OVERLINE growth reaches atmospheric layers; runoff amplifies growth and fruits enneract constructs.
TRUNK_BASE seam entities convert organic matter into NATIVE_Lifestring, feeding branches and ROOT_SEAM.
Sap and waveform extraction have Merc Tag, black.dot and fractech requirements.
ROOT_SEAM sensory and memetic effects are ArK_SPECIFIC; named constructs remain specific to the source.

lighting.direction: Use wet biomass and restrained runic spill at local scale; branches and atmospheric silhouette must preserve the source’s immense scale.

constraints: No independent atlas position is confirmed here.
Conversion is dangerous source lore, not an arbitrary decorative animation or free resource.
ArK particulate processes and NULL_FIELD particulate processes must not be collapsed into one mechanism.

profiles.label: Snail Wood

facts.text: Hibernating or dead arcane_mollusks form bio-gel stalks; empty shells house arcane_magus and necramancers.
ARCANE_MAGUS_3.33 is a specific ageless teacher and accidental exile-captive near the border.
Harvet’s fracTECH.NODE_ReF_3.12 provides contracts, intel and oversight including encap risk.
HOVEL-REG>CASC> combines preTECH street lamps, pilgrimage rest, vending and residential rentals.
Rental access depends on reputation, foothold.measure and faction alignment; several property forms are enumerated.

lighting.direction: Distinguish tactile shells and gel from street lighting and distant contract-node projection. The source does not fix a universal shell color.

constraints: Death and hibernation are distinct states even when both have a stalk motif.
Do not conjure a new corpse or dwelling because a reference was read.
Snail Wood has no established travel coordinate in the current atlas.

profiles.label: Mesas_D.S.CONV / Mesas.D.S.CONV

facts.text: The skyline is visible from ENACT_HILLS; southern darkness is filled with neon and NODE.TRAIL requires clearance tags.
SGS supplies gas.op, merchTINE and enerwu; fuel and drink extraction uses vind-sec and ArK.FOREST.
MOCKTRAKT makes specified cordline framegens; LYNtech has transport and community origins.
<<<cryillistics<<< wirelets have distinct modes and contract consequences; qualitative ranges are enumerated.
Nailyn’s disappearance is source history; it is not permission to generate her as a present companion.
MID.LINE_TRACK and HIGH_LAND.TRAX have distinct access, traffic and service-worker protocols.
STAT.D is inaccessible behind the expanded gate; archival reports include displaced construction and aging hypotheses.
BLACK.HAT is a large salvaged under-freeway marketplace; its layout can change while border turrets stay fixed.
KHO.DEV shares a name with KHO but has no connection to the processing intelligence.

lighting.direction: Use brand-specific practicals: gas.op red, deep metallic vehicle tones, violet crystallin armaments and separated blue/green service signatures from the test images.

constraints: Relative visibility does not establish a precise atlas coordinate.
Vehicle ranges and speeds are qualitative; do not invent AP, damage, speed or fuel values from product art.
STATION_DEGRADE / STAT.D is archival and inaccessible, not an automatically opened dungeon.
KHO.DEV must not impersonate KHO.
A street-racing system and rearranging collision topology need implementation beyond this intake.

profiles.label: NULL_FIELD.OMNI / PLATEAU<SCARLET<

facts.text: NanoClad reports distinguish AETHER-following primary structures from an independent gold secondary structure.
DIAMON.D continually flakes and reforms; its color follows filtered light through RED>GATE>.
YU.ZU_CaPSULaTE constrains weather and bio-nano fields; research stations have specific observation and transfer protocols.
Laser_rain, tess.shard-fall and ennerCHILL have distinct material and growth effects.
PYR_REZ maintains sun-like illumination; laser_rain activates a teal capstone that affects nearby growth.
The feather-like construct collects particulates through weather-driven tendrils.
BIOME_AQUI.EXPANSE is described through uncertain scouts’ reports and ceramic-tree observations.
SCRATCH-LINE.SURFACE remains stable regardless of the observed stimulus; no bio-nano growth occurs there.
Frac.GEO_NODENACT and MTN_INFI_VOID_SPACE_OMNI have unresolved competing composition theories.
The document defines one ib as 0.5 miles for its local reports.

lighting.direction: Treat jade/rose following, independent gold, steady pyramid light and conditional teal as separate observed signatures; no universal rainbow tint.

constraints: Existing access is remote interpretation; RED>GATE> remains closed.
UNKNOWN_structure and composition theories remain unknown.
ibs is source-local; it does not establish a continent-to-survey-grid transform.
Reports are not verified material composition or calibrated physical measurement.
profiles.placement: remote reports only; gate boundary retained

profiles.label: io_COMBI_oi

facts.text: A miles-high bio-glass mega-city offers pilgrims and civilians sustainable omni-meta services and bio-nano self-expression.
ContriFID is low priority within this city.

lighting.direction: Use readable glass mass and internal structure; hue, districts and detailed architecture remain art adaptations.

constraints: Only a short overview exists; detailed factions, dialogue and district topology are not documented.
Do not transplant Mesas or WN clearance policies wholesale into this city.

profiles.label: mollusk_crescent_MOONLAND

facts.text: Twilight sands contain wild-born arcane_mollusks, hibernating adults, larval construction and terraforming extract.

lighting.direction: Twilight is explicit; colors and the unfinished imbuement mechanism remain undetermined.

constraints: The complete recovered DOCX ends mid-sentence at "imbued through".
Do not complete the missing mechanism or infer lunar coordinates from the name.

unresolved_source_tensions.subject: druid terminology
unresolved_source_tensions.note: Mesas paragraph 170 defines druid as a role under fractech; other passages speak of Druid-Sec faction/CORP-E practices. Keep the passage context rather than silently resolving organizational identity.

unresolved_source_tensions.note: The name FINAL suggests a revision, but author-confirmed precedence and formal executable equivalence are not supplied.

integration.behavior: Read-only deterministic generation context, sensory prose and skill-checked NPC biome briefings. Optional narrator receives only the current region and explicit evidence boundaries.
integration.inactive_profiles: Unplaced source profiles are available to authoring tools; no new routes, resources, powers or NPC identities are materialized.
integration.physics: Numerical physics, VREX, photonics and research kernels retain their bytes. Reference dynamics remain requirements until their mechanics and assets are implemented.
integration.art: The original four images are available from the reference archive. Existing prepared assets and art manifests retain their bytes.
